newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa industrials end at new high, golds down.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa industrials end at new high, golds down.

text.p: South African industrial shares, unfased by a lower-than-expected reserves figure, climbed to their fifth consecutive record high fuelled by gains in heavyweight stock Richemont.
But the gold index sank to a fresh 4 -1/4 year low, dragged down by bullion which too fixed at a new trough.

Dealers said arbitrage trading between the spot and futures market, which roared ahead on Tuesday welcoming the milestone relaxation of foreign exchange controls on individuals on that day, lifted several key industrial index stocks.
Since Tuesday individuals can invest a once-off 200,000 rand offshore.
Gains on the bond and rand markets were further boons.
The industrial index finished up 23.8 points at 8,832.5 but the gold ended down 3.9 points at 964.7, leaving the all share index off 3.4 at 7,416.7.
